summary: The 8-K filed by Antares Private Credit Fund on April 30, 2026, discloses a regular distribution of $0.1818 per share, the NAV per share ($24.57) and aggregate NAV ($795.6M) as of March 31, 2026, along with debt-to-equity and net leverage ratios, and updates on its continuous offering of up to $2.0B in shares (32.4M shares issued for $811.8M to date). These are routine operational updates—regular distribution declaration and periodic NAV/offering disclosure—not a special situation. No M&A, restructuring, or activist activity is present. Dividend and NAV reporting for a BDC is standard. Category: None.
